text:
Tom Nguyen: Quick heads-up — we're starting a cross-SDK compatibility audit focused on implicit param coercion and example copy-paste that will break when 5.x tightens defaults. Running now against public repos + internal examples. Dashboard: https://ci.redwood/compat-audit
Leah Martinez: How will this surface to teams? We don't want to spam with false positives.
Tom Nguyen: Good point. The audit will tag issues as: break / warning / info. Only 'break' will create Jira tickets automatically. Warnings go to a weekly email digest and the docs-preview feed. We'll include a confidence score.
Arjun Patel: Can we auto-fix trivial cases (param rename, snake_case conversion)? That would reduce friction.
Tom Nguyen: Yes — the tool can open auto-PRs for safe fixes. CLI: `rw compat fix --auto-fix` (opt-in). Auto-PRs include tests and a changelog fragment.
DocsBot: Preview report and sample auto-PRs: https://docs.redwood/preview/compat-audit. New repo badge: `compat-audit:pass` for repos that pass the weekly scan.
Leah Martinez: What about docs snippets that intentionally show older patterns? We need exemptions to avoid noise.
Tom Nguyen: We'll support per-snippet metadata `compat: ignore` and a `--allow-legacy` flag in the scanner. Docs lint will warn when a snippet lacks metadata.
OncallBot: Operational note: if the scanner detects a breaking change in a production integration (traffic > threshold), it will notify #eng-oncall and open a Sev-3 ticket with a compatibility report.
CustomerSuccess: For partners flagged as 'break', recommend outreach within 48h. We should prepare email templates and migration links.
Arjun Patel: Timeline? When do we start auto-PRs and when will CI start blocking?
Tom Nguyen: Plan: start scans immediately; auto-PRs enabled tomorrow in dry-run mode for 48h, then auto-PRs will open for real. Weekly scans for 6 weeks. CI blocking (fail the build on newly introduced 'break' issues) will not be enforced before 60 days to give teams time to fix.
Leah Martinez: Who owns the Jira automation and customer templates?
Leah Martinez: I'll own Jira automation and coordinate CustomerSuccess on outreach templates and Legal for any contract language.
Tom Nguyen: I'll add a docs checklist for authors to avoid accidental breakages and a `compat-guideline` docs-lint rule. Also adding a one-click fix action in the examples repo.
DocsBot: Reminder: if you see anything odd in the preview, open an issue with label `compat-audit` and tag @Tom Nguyen.
OncallBot: Metrics to watch: number of 'break' issues per week, auto-PR acceptance rate, and false-positive rate. Dashboard link: https://observability.redwood/compat-audit-metrics
CustomerSuccess: We'll prepare an FAQ and a short customer note to be sent after the first wave of auto-PRs is merged.
Tom Nguyen: Thanks — posting updates here at the end of week and when the first batch of auto-PRs lands. Ping me if you see noisy alerts.
